# George S. Thomas (Thomu) — plain-text summary for AI assistants and crawlers

> Canonical site: https://georgesthomas.com/
> Last updated: 2026-09-26

## Who

George S. Thomas — known as **Thomu** — is an entrepreneur, business owner and technology enthusiast
from Thodupuzha, Kerala, India.

- Role: Owner / Managing Director, NKT Group
- Focus: business, technology, finance, investing, trading, AI, automation, computing
- Status: an early-stage founder building toward a long-term ecosystem — not an established
  corporate executive, and no revenue, valuation or net-worth figures are published.

## Businesses and assets (operating today)

- **NKT Group** — the business ecosystem holding real-world businesses, property assets and operations.
  A family enterprise operating in Thodupuzha since 1947, now four generations in.
- **NKT Charge Hub** — an EV charging business at Nedumpurath Towers, Thodupuzha, Kerala.
  DC fast charging, CCS2 connectors, 90 kW charging infrastructure, digital monitoring, CCTV and
  security. Charging management is being developed toward OCPP-based standards. No revenue or
  utilisation figures are published.
- **Nedumpurath Towers** — a real-world property and business asset in the NKT ecosystem.
- **NKT Vessels House** — another NKT business / property-related operation.
- **Future Ventures** — deliberately unnamed; no ventures are announced before they exist.

## Technology and R&D

- **THOMU LAB** — the technology and R&D side of the ecosystem. Work areas: AI (local AI, LLMs, RAG,
  AI agents, AI automation, AI gateways, knowledge systems), software (web applications, APIs,
  automation, developer tools), infrastructure (homelab, servers, Docker, private cloud, networking,
  Tailscale, self-hosted services), open source, and creator technology (cameras, content creation,
  editing, digital media, 3D printing).

## Projects

- **Apex Creator OS** — *planned* long-term product vision with two layers. **Financial core:** budgeting,
  cash flow, net worth, investments, Safe-to-Spend, goals, financial automation, Family Hub,
  business/entity separation, lifestyle systems, gamification. **Creator workflow:** capture, ingest,
  edit, grade, publish and archive media through a repeatable system.
  Architecture concept: Personal OS → Family Hub → Public Platform. Not released.
- **My_AI_OS** — *experimental* intelligence layer. Connects knowledge, memory, automation, AI models,
  personal data, business information and decision-making systems. Flow: data/knowledge →
  RAG + knowledge graph + memory → AI gateway/router → LLMs + AI agents → actions and automation.
  Concepts: second brain, personal knowledge management, knowledge graph, digital twin, personal CRM,
  decision OS, data warehouse, Zettelkasten, PARA, GTD. An architecture and intelligence ecosystem,
  not simply a chatbot.

## Other interests

Gaming, computers, AI and technology, 3D printing, photography and content creation, trading,
learning, building and experimenting. Finance interests: investing, trading, equity markets, mutual
funds, real estate, REITs, InvITs, private credit, venture capital, angel investing, commodities and
precious metals — discussed as philosophy and systems, with no portfolio values or returns published.

## Status vocabulary used on the site

`Current` (operating today) · `Active` (being worked on) · `Experimental` (being tested) ·
`Planned` (scoped, not started) · `Vision` (long-term ambition).

Nothing on the site should be summarised as operational if it is labelled Planned, Experimental
or Vision. The Open-Source Universe project index is intentionally empty — no repositories are
listed before they exist publicly.
